algorithm: Split scalar classes of at least 1024 point inputs into independent 512-point subtrees. Final affine point sums keep the same class scalar.
eligibility: Each timed curve must show admitted long classes on both exact inputs. Joint timing needs admissions for G1 and G2. Verify no admissions at zero optional workspace.
criterion: Absolute paired ordinary versus frozen median <=2%. A candidate needs a negative paired median and at least 6/8 faster process means against both on both inputs.
clock_diagnostic: Three separate blocks with query and class traces. Clocked results are diagnostic.
